For a vararg method invoked with zero arguments (e.g. verify(mock).noArgVarargCall()), matchers is empty and rawArguments.length == matchers.size() == 0 makes isVararg true, so lastMatcher() calls matchers.get(-1) and throws IndexOutOfBoundsException — a case the previous ordering avoided entirely."}]
